description: This file defines the 'Article' result class for the Coocook schema, including database table mapping, relationships, and utility methods related to articles.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Article
classes.description: Result class representing articles in the database, with relationships to tags, units, dishes, recipes, and other related entities.

methods.name: unit_ids_joined
methods.description: Returns a string of unit IDs joined by a separator, representing the units associated with the article.

methods.name: units_in_use
methods.description: Checks if the units associated with the article are currently in use.

methods.name: tags_joined
methods.description: Returns a string of tag names associated with the article, joined by spaces.
